import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int N = 1 << 20; // 2^20

    static long bp(long x, long y) {
        long z = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1)
                z = z * x % MOD;
            x = x * x % MOD;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long[][] p = new long[6][6]; // default 0

        long inv100 = bp(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = val * inv100 % MOD;
            }
        }

        for (int i = n; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = n; j < 6; j++)
                p[i][j] = 1;

        // First set of edges: (i, j) with i=0..5, j=0..2
        List<int[]> E = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});

        int[] m = new int[1 << 18];
        int nump = 0;

        // Part 1: build m array from permutations of triples (i,j,k) with i<j<k
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; k++) {
                    // All 6 permutations of {i,j,k}
                    int[][] perms = {
                        {i, j, k}, {i, k, j},
                        {j, i, k}, {j, k, i},
                        {k, i, j}, {k, j, i}
                    };
                    for (int[] perm : perms) {
                        int mask1 = (1 << (perm[0] * 3)) ^
                                     (1 << (perm[1] * 3 + 1)) ^
                                     (1 << (perm[2] * 3 + 2));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1) {
                                m[mask] |= (1 << nump);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    nump++;
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute F array
        long[] F = new long[1 << 20];
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                int u = E.get(i)[0], vv = E.get(i)[1];
                if ((mask >> i & 1) == 1)
                    v = v * p[u][vv] % MOD;
                else
                    v = v * (1 - p[u][vv] + MOD) % MOD;
            }
            int idx = m[mask];
            F[idx] = (F[idx] + v) % MOD;
        }

        // SOS DP (subset convolution)
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); mask++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    F[mask] = (F[mask] + F[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        // Reset m and nump for second part
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) m[i] = 0;
        nump = 0;

        // Part 2: same but for complement triples
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; k++) {
                    // Build complement list of the three indices not in {i,j,k}
                    int[] comp = new int[3];
                    int idx = 0;
                    for (int x = 0; x < 6; x++) {
                        if (x != i && x != j && x != k) {
                            comp[idx++] = x;
                        }
                    }
                    // Permutations of complement
                    int[][] perms = {
                        {comp[0], comp[1], comp[2]},
                        {comp[0], comp[2], comp[1]},
                        {comp[1], comp[0], comp[2]},
                        {comp[1], comp[2], comp[0]},
                        {comp[2], comp[0], comp[1]},
                        {comp[2], comp[1], comp[0]}
                    };
                    for (int[] perm : perms) {
                        int mask1 = (1 << (perm[0] * 3)) ^
                                     (1 << (perm[1] * 3 + 1)) ^
                                     (1 << (perm[2] * 3 + 2));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1) {
                                m[mask] |= (1 << nump);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    nump++;
                }
            }
        }

        // Build second set of edges: (i, j) with i=0..5, j=3..5
        E.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = 3; j < 6; j++)
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});

        // Compute answer
        long ans = 0;
        int fullMask = (1 << 20) - 1;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                int u = E.get(i)[0], vv = E.get(i)[1];
                if ((mask >> i & 1) == 1)
                    v = v * p[u][vv] % MOD;
                else
                    v = v * (1 - p[u][vv] + MOD) % MOD;
            }
            int idx = m[mask];
            long add = (1 - F[fullMask ^ idx] + MOD) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + v * add) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
